description: Get the shareable link of an endpoint (a read-only page with its docs, examples and latest run, secrets hidden), who can open it and who was invited. Use it to put the link in a PR, an issue or a message. Each endpoint has one link that never changes; `shared: false` means it has none yet (see share_api_endpoint).

endpoint_id.description: Id of the endpoint. Alternative to method + path.

method.description: HTTP method of the route, e.g. POST. Use with path instead of endpoint_id.

path.description: Route path as written in the code, e.g. /v1/charges/:id or /v1/charges/{id}.

name: get_api_share_link
